name: clamav-monitor
description: Desktop monitor and configuration UI for the local ClamAV setup
author: Expansive Labs <derek@expansivelabs.io>

_comments.desktopName: Must sit at package.json root, not under build.linux (the schema rejects it there, and rejects unknown keys inside `build` too). Electron uses it as app_id / WM_CLASS; linux.syncDesktopName makes the installed .desktop filename match, so the window links to its launcher entry.
_comments.productName: build.productName is deliberately hyphenated rather than 'ClamAV Monitor': it determines the install directory, and a space there makes Chromium's zygote re-exec split the path -- execvp('/opt/ClamAV') -> FATAL on every desktop launch, while a terminal launch via the symlink still works. The human-readable name comes from build.linux.desktop.entry.Name.

scripts.lint: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check renderer/app.js && bash -n helper/clamav-monitor-helper && bash -n scripts/install-helper.sh && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json'))"
scripts.dist:all: npm run icon && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage

linux.description: Monitor and configure ClamAV protection: service status, signature freshness, scans, and logs.
